items.label: Signal Watch Live Wallpaper is a live wallpaper from Apex Air Solutions for your phone or tablet. It turns your home screen into a signal command center: a live scope of the Wi-Fi around you, every network named with its strength, in board colours you pick. Price: $10. Find it in the Apex Library, on the faces shelf.

Price: $10. Find it in the Apex Library, on the faces shelf.

items.name: Holly's Dragon Egg Hatch — wireframe watch face (v1)
items.source: Built Nov 9, 2026 for Holly (record: ~/memory/2026-11-09.md, 21:51 EST) — all-wireframe stroke-only dragon egg hatch face; 13 purples, zero pink; tap = peck, cracks creep ~1 stage/20 h (hatch ~4 days), dragon climbs out, rib-fan wings, smoke ring; bench passed (palette parity 13/13, 0 external refs, live interaction runs). Never hung; ingested Nov 26, 2026 for Holly's test bed. Original house dragon art — no third-party IP.

items.name: Holly Dragon Wallpaper — live wallpaper (v1.0)
items.source: Built Nov 25, 2026 to Holly's spec (record: ~/memory/2026-11-25.md) — tail-chasing wireframe dragon in the center, purple dragons flying in the background, purple 0/1 waterfall; package com.apexairsolutions.hollydragon, v1.0 (vc1); INSTALL-FACE CHECK passed (label 'Holly Dragon Wallpaper', dragon-ring icon); pixel audit zero pink, purples only; no permissions, no network, fully offline. Delivered in thread Nov 25; on-device grade still Holly's. Original house dragon art — no third-party IP.
items.label: Holly Dragon Wallpaper is a live wallpaper from Apex Air Solutions, built for Holly. A big wireframe dragon chases its tail in the center of the screen, smaller purple dragons fly around it, and purple 0s and 1s fall like rain behind them — purples only, no pink. It needs no permissions and no network. Price: not set yet. Find it in the Apex Library, on the faces shelf.
